about: µLearn CHN is a dynamic community powered by GTech, dedicated to fostering growth through mutual learning. We bring together curious minds to explore new ideas, develop skills, and collaborate on innovative projects. Our community thrives on peer learning, mentorship, and hands-on experiences, empowering individuals to grow both personally and professionally.Join us and be part of a movement that transforms learning into action!

events.head: Make(Me)²
events.para: A fun-filled meme-making competition organized as part of Women's Day, where teams unleash their creativity to craft witty and engaging memes on a given topic. Participants can select any template from the provided list to bring their ideas to life!

events.head: Change the Look
events.para: A creative challenge introduced as a follow-up to the Introduction to Figma workshop from the µQuest series. Students take a random poster and redesign it with their unique creative touch, enhancing their Figma skills.

events.head: Introduction to Figma
events.para: A two-day session designed to familiarize students with Figma and its essential tools. This workshop marked the launch of the µQuest series, setting the stage for hands-on learning and creative exploration.

events.head: µQUEST
events.para: µQUEST is a workshop and challenge series designed to educate students and guide them through Level 3 tasks on Discord, enhancing their skills and engagement.

events.head: Karma Fest
events.para: A 2-day event to onboard students to Discord, boost campus karma points, and increase participation in µLearn through fun challenges and interactive sessions.
